title: Review Visits for a Surgical Recommendation under Second Opinion (Primary Care Provider Assignment)
content:
**Utilization management clause — Primary Care Provider Assignment, second-opinion referrals where the recommendation under review is a surgery.**

Review visits are added to a second-opinion referral's visits for the recommendation under review, before the single-referral visit ceiling is applied, according to the status of the member's **Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization** request under **Prior Authorization**:

- while that request is in **submitted** or **pended-for-information** status, the review visits are the visits recorded on the current assignment's single referrals to the requesting provider — the provider who requested that authorization — added together, divided by the visits-per-review count of **4** and rounded down to a whole visit;
- while it is **approved**, the review visits are the flat single review visit: **1** visit;
- with no such request in any of those statuses, no review visit is added.

**Branch table**

| Status of the Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization request | Review visits |
|---|---|
| Submitted | Visits on the current assignment's single referrals to the requesting provider, divided by 4, rounded down |
| Pended for information | The same as submitted |
| Approved | 1 |
| Denied, expired, voided or withdrawn, or no request | 0 |

**Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)**

| Request status | Visits recorded on the current assignment's single referrals to the requesting provider | Review visits |
|---|---|---|
| Submitted | 6 and 4 (10 in all) | 10 divided by 4 is 2.5, rounded down to 2 |
| Pended for information | 8 | 8 divided by 4 is 2 |
| Submitted | 3 | 3 divided by 4 is 0.75, rounded down to 0 |
| Submitted | No single referral to the requesting provider on the current assignment | 0 |
| Approved | Any | 1 |
